name: crypto cipher deterministic output
source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; import { createCipheriv } from 'node:crypto'; function main(): void { const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-cbc', Buffer.alloc(32), Buffer.alloc(16)); const first = cipher.update('hello'); const last = cipher.final(); console.log(Buffer.concat([first, last]).toString('hex')); }
